paragraphs: On Saturday, May and Pat go to the shop near school. Pat starts school on Monday, and he needs new things. May has the list from the school website. "What's this?" asks Pat. "It's an eraser," says May. "You use it when you make a mistake." Pat laughs and says, "I never make a mistake!" "Everyone makes a mistake," says May.

May teaches Pat the names of the things in the shop. "What's that?" asks Pat. "It's a ruler," says May. "It's long and thin." Pat holds the ruler next to his arm. He laughs because it is as long as his arm. Then he sees a big box of colors. "What's this?" he asks. "They're crayons," says May. "You draw with them." They put paper, crayons, and an eraser in the basket.

At the counter, May reads the text on the list again. It says one ruler, one eraser, paper, and crayons. Pat has two rulers in his hand. "That's a mistake!" says May. "Oh no!" says Pat. The woman at the counter laughs, and everyone smiles. "All right, I put one back," says Pat. May sends a text to Mom: "We have everything." Mom writes back, "Good job!" Pat can't wait for Monday.
text.summary: May takes Pat to a shop to buy school things from a list. Pat asks "What's this?" about each thing and makes a small mistake at the counter.
